description: The Hexbin Scatterplot is a custom visual for Microsoft Power BI that displays points on top of hexagonal "bins". Color saturation for the hexbins shows the density of points within each bin, with darker bins showing more points. Functionality Hexbins - Add hexagonal bins behind the points of the scatterplot. Bins show the density of points using color, with darker bins representing more points in that bin. Points- View points in a cartesian plane.
